rules.title: pip installs repeated

estimate.assumption: uv resolves and installs 5-50x faster than pip with a warm cache; 0.7 is conservative

rules.why: pip resolves and installs serially and rebuilds wheels.
rules.fix: Use uv (uv venv, uv pip install, uv sync, or `uv run --with pkg`).
rules.after: uv venv && uv pip install -r requirements.txt

rules.title: Whole pytest suite rerun after small edits

estimate.assumption: running only failed/affected tests is typically 3-10x cheaper than the full suite

rules.why: The same full suite is the feedback loop for every edit.
rules.fix: Loop with --lf / -k / the one file, add -x and -n auto (xdist), run the full suite once at the end.
rules.after: pytest --lf -x   # then pytest -n auto once at the end
